name: @hydra/dsh-fleet-watchdog
description: Prototype: the V3 verification gate on stopped work (issue #26, orchestration-v3 §4 P2.4, #28 — paperclip Task Watchdog). When every leaf of a watched task tree rests, the watchdog verifies the stop against evidence (artifact contract present? evidence non-empty? metric in passRange?) — verification-shaped, no LLM. It rejects false 'done': reopens the leaf, creates a marked review task, and reassigns it via org-chart role routing to restore a live path. Stop-fingerprint reuse (bus dedupe semantics) suppresses re-verification on identical stopped state within a window; every event publishes with originKind 'watchdog' (self-trigger guard). Registers ctx.fleetWatchdog + the watchdog_watch / watchdog_verify / watchdog_status tools. Issue #26.
